title: Beacons - pre emulation of social cortex
description: primitive emulation of social cortex currently only about tagging object types and labeled objects in simulations and having them refer to a table of  category and response, which might include a sim of their own sensitive to cues such as mood or transferable cues of  when the object type is called; then "emulated" in the mind a pulse-to-response only version of the associated objects for this purpose ( should update with more social cortex posits soon )

methods.name: Cat-in-environment thought scenario for a simulated agent
methods.description: The design is framed around a single agent (a cat) perceiving an environment of objects, each treated as a signal-publishing beacon.
methods.evidence: Beacons are vision-labeled objects in a simulation, Though all of them is able to be considered as a Publisher of Signal (a beacon)

methods.name: Pattern-scan and labeling procedure with object-type codes
methods.description: A numbered formal process scans vision for patterns, ranks them by significance, and assigns labels such as OTSP, OTSA, OTSB and OTSSB by object type.
methods.evidence: 1. Scan everything in vision for PATTERNS 2. Label all patterns and divide them by Significance

methods.name: Beacons table with confirmation and weight pulses
methods.description: Sketches building a beacons table, checking nearest object types, then publishing pulses as weights onto the agent's simulation.
methods.evidence: Make beacons table Run a process to check nearest, run confirmation

methods.name: Baseline-to-learned epigenetic reaction tables
methods.description: Beacon processing trees are encoded in a table that starts from an inherited baseline of reactions and is modified by learning.
methods.evidence: Starts from a Baseline (Inherited) reactionary table of actions Onto a Learned (modified) reactionary table of actions (reactions in this case).

key_findings: Proposes classifying entities on a certainty spectrum, from predictable (walls, rocks) to highly dynamic social entities carrying their own prediction matrix.
Introduces a self-social (OTSSA) label so identities can be represented and swapped into social-social simulations in place of another social creature.
Notes that biologically objects may first be treated as social and then downgraded, but the sketch deliberately starts bottom-up for an optimized working agent.
States the aim of building an agent by attaching any vision model to a labeling regime, which the authors flag as subject to change.
key_findings_evidence: But for optimization reasons; these are then classified onto a certainty spectrum. Some of them are almost absolutely predictable , such as Walls, Rocks. etc
This way; Identities (any psychological equivalent) are able to be represented As if they are whispering selves that adds weight or simulatable despite not being very clearly depicted
this reality actually implies that objects are initially labeled as Social) instead of the other way around
We hope to construct an agent by attaching a (any) Vision Model With the appropriate labeling regime
